scope: Host restart while a task-agent commission is waiting on a report-style user question after its run/session has become idle or closed.

native_gap.overbroad_reconcile: Ledger._reconcile currently includes every waiting_user row from a prior host in the fail-on-open set.
native_gap.safe_native_resume_path: TaskAgentManager._answer_closed explicitly supports a waiting_user commission whose pending question kind is report, appends an answered/resumed event, and calls the existing _take_up_again transcript-tail path.
native_gap.durable_question: pending_question is stored on the commission and unsent question delivery is stored in the native outbox. outbox_question_state considers an unsent question current exactly while the commission remains waiting_user.
native_gap.ownership_transfer: The first accepted transition from waiting_user to working writes the new Ledger.instance to host_instance, so no separate ownership field/store is needed.
native_gap.native_session: session_id/session_dir/runtime and transcript are already durable and reopened by the normal TaskAgentManager path.

important_exclusion.tool_or_permission_questions: TaskAgentManager._answer_closed deliberately refuses questions whose kind is not report because the coroutine/Future that issued a tool/permission ask died with the old process. Those remain a separate blocker and MUST still fail/reconcile rather than being silently preserved.
important_exclusion.working_commissions: No working commission is admitted here; an interrupted external effect can be uncertain.
important_exclusion.queued_commissions: No queued auto-restart is admitted here; this unit only preserves an already-user-blocked report checkpoint.

reuse_order.candidate: N.E.K.O current pin Ledger + TaskAgentManager._answer_closed + native outbox
reuse_order.reason: All persistence, question identity, transcript resume and ownership transfer primitives already exist.
No newer upstream host-restart report-wait preservation exists at review time.
Use existing commission pending_question, session transcript and question outbox; no plugin/MCP/private state is required.
No pinned provider owns this host-internal report checkpoint.
Would duplicate N.E.K.O ledger/session/outbox for a checkpoint already fully represented natively.
Exclude only prior-host waiting_user rows whose durable pending_question kind is report from fail-on-open; leave every other restart policy unchanged.

candidate_contract.preserve_only: status=waiting_user AND pending_question parses as object with kind=report
candidate_contract.outbox: Do not delete an unsent native question row for the preserved report wait. Existing outbox sender decides whether it still needs delivery.
candidate_contract.resume: The user's answer must go through existing Host.answer -> TaskBrain.answer -> TaskAgentManager._answer_closed -> _take_up_again. No startup model call and no automatic effect occurs.
candidate_contract.ownership: The normal waiting_user -> working transition adopts the current host_instance.

machine_acceptance: Ledger reopen preserves a prior-host report waiting_user row and its unsent question outbox.
Ledger reopen still fails permission/tool waiting_user rows and removes their stale unsent question.
Native queued/working restart-failure behavior remains unchanged.
A new host can answer the preserved report wait and resume at the existing transcript tail with started.resumed=true.
No model/runtime work starts merely because the new Ledger/Host is opened.
retirement_condition: Delete this candidate when upstream N.E.K.O natively preserves report-style waiting_user commissions across host restart with equivalent durable-question, transcript-tail resume, no-startup-effect and exclusion coverage for permission/tool questions.
conclusion: THIN_NATIVE_RECONCILE_CANDIDATE. Preserve only a checkpoint N.E.K.O can already resume safely; do not generalize to permission or in-flight effect recovery.
